basic_info.description: Set on a quiet, coveted block in the Marina, this exquisitely renovated top floor home has been tastefully updated throughout, with beautiful original details preserved including matchstick hardwood floors and high ceilings. The chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances and is perfectly arranged for entertaining. The living room includes a sophisticated drybar and an elegant stone fireplace. The luxe master bedroom suite awaits at the back of the home. An expansive, private roofdeck with views of the Golden Gate and Palace of Fine Arts is exclusive to this unit and boasts a stone kitchen island with built-in grill/refrigerator/sink (plumbed gas/water/electricity). In-unit washer/dryer, generous closet space, 2 car parking and abundant deeded storage complete this exceptional home. A++ location, a few blocks from the many shops, cafes and restaurants of Chestnut Street and the recreation areas of the Presidio, Marina Green, and Crissy Field Beach. This is San Francisco living at its very best.
